code_authority.interpretation: Intrinsic assignment of the table value on every cache hit deep-copies allocatable support arrays into the provider-owned table.

finding: Warm adaptive-provider acquisition is material: one cache-hit bind costs about 31 percent of a 16-head adaptive constitutive evaluation in this microbenchmark.
repair_boundary: Separate immutable representation ownership in the shared cache from cheap step-duration-dependent analytical fallback binding. Do not change hydraulic representation, error gates, routing, dry-tail semantics or default-off behavior.
nonclaims: This is a lifecycle microbenchmark, not an application-level speedup.
The 31 percent ratio does not imply the same fraction of total Richards or FMR runtime.
